name: Simple Redirect
description: Config-entity-based 301 redirects: an admin defines internal from->to path pairs, applied by a kernel.request subscriber on exact request-URI match.
project_description:
A lightweight module that provides users to have URL redirects in the websites. It is powered by Drupal Entity concept.

 Features covered 
 
 With this module Admins are given an option to add a redirect from the sites internal urls to the another url within site. 
 Admins can add/update/delete as many as such redirects within the site. 
 Admins can use the url aliases of the content as well for the redirects. 
 
 Installation
 
 
 Same as other drupal modules 
 
 Configuration 
 
 After enabling the module, navigate to the url /admin/config/search/simple-redirect . 
 You see a button to Add Simple Redirect, click on this. 
 You will land on the Add page, where you can input the title, from & to urls. Save the redirect. 
 Try the from url on the browser, you can see the redirection. 
 Back to top
